The authors' code was run unchanged in a clean environment set up with the R
version the authors declared or, if they declared none, the one current when
the materials were deposited, and with packages as CRAN held them on the
snapshot date. This report records what happened. Whether
the results match those reported in the article is assessed by the checker in
the checklist issue.
